# Google Material Symbols

Copyright Google LLC. Apache License 2.0; the complete license is in LICENSE.txt.
This is an official Google Fonts Material Symbols Outlined subset retrieved
2026-10-06. The upstream response is retained in source-css.txt as provenance;
it is not a runtime stylesheet. The font and application CSS are served locally.
No Google or third-party requests are made by the workbench.

Official guide: https://developers.google.com/fonts/docs/material_symbols
Upstream: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons

Axes: optical size 20, weight 400, fill 0–1, grade -25–0. Chrome renders the
20 px symbols at their designed optical size. Controls use fill for selected
state; grade is 0 in light appearance and -25 for reduced glare in dark
appearance. Symbols supplement text; decorative glyphs are hidden from the
accessibility tree. Icon-only buttons have independent accessible names.

Subset SHA-256: cdb0714c84d116b6cee39d4d9f3f468c6abdf18f29a72eef0aaac00d9a96a2f5
Google Fonts API response version: v375.

Reproduction URL (development asset retrieval only):
https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:opsz,wght,FILL,GRAD@20,400,0..1,-25..0&icon_names=dark_mode,description,download,expand_less,expand_more,fact_check,folder_open,graphic_eq,headphones,history,light_mode,link,notes,pause,play_arrow,repeat,search,skip_next,tune,unfold_more,view_agenda,view_sidebar,volume_off,volume_up&display=block

Request with a modern Chrome user agent to receive WOFF2. Before replacing the
asset, verify its wOF2 signature, update the digest and response version here,
and inspect all glyphs in both appearances. Keep the source response and license
in the built UI and preview package. The subset lives in
ui/src/assets/material-symbols-subset.woff2 in corresponding source.
